items.title: How a cookie is set and read
steps: The site sends a small file to the browser
The browser sends the cookie back
items.why: The cookie is stored once, then sent back every time the visitor returns.

items.title: How a clean room match works
steps: The clean room matches them privately
Rules limit what can be seen
Only combined, aggregate results come out
items.why: The matching happens inside the clean room, and only safe results leave it.
